'''Arnoldas Kulboka''' (born 5 January 1998) is a Lithuanian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Promitheas Patras B.C.|Promitheas Patras]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]]. He was selected by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] with the 55th overall pick in the [[2018 NBA draft]]. At {{height|m=2.06}}, he can play at both [[forward (basketball)|forward]] positions.

==Professional career==

===Žalgiris-2 (2014–2015)===
Kulboka played in the youth ranks of [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] with the club's [[reserve team]], [[BC Žalgiris-2|Žalgiris-2 Kaunas]].

===Brose Bamberg (2015–2017)===
Kulboka signed a five-year deal with German powerhouse [[Brose Bamberg]] in August 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.brosebamberg.de/unser-team/das-team-201617/11-arnoldas-kulboka/|title=#11 Arnoldas Kulboka - Brose Bamberg|website=brosebamberg.de|access-date=13 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161114002350/http://www.brosebamberg.de/unser-team/das-team-201617/11-arnoldas-kulboka/|archive-date=14 November 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> In his first year, he exclusively saw action on their affiliated teams in the German under-19 youth Bundesliga NBBL (TSV Breitengüßbach), and in the second German division [[ProA|2. Bundesliga ProA]] ([[Baunach Young Pikes]]). He helped Breitengüßbach capture the 2016 NBBL title,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tsvbrgb.de/index.php/nbbl/659-nbbl-ist-deutscher-meister-2016|title=TSV Breitengüßbach e.V. - NBBL IST DEUTSCHER MEISTER 2016|last=Ahlf|first=Lina-Theresa|website=tsvbrgb.de|access-date=13 November 2016|archive-date=5 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705232034/https://www.tsvbrgb.de/index.php/nbbl/659-nbbl-ist-deutscher-meister-2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> while averaging 6.4 points, as well as 1.5 rebounds a contest for Baunach in ProA play.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.zweite-basketball-bundesliga.de/teams/kader/spieler/2486/?|title=2. Basketball-Bundesliga {{!}} Spieler|website=zweite-basketball-bundesliga.de|access-date=13 November 2016}}</ref> In 2016, he attended the [[Basketball Without Borders]] Global Camp in [[Toronto]], Canada,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Arnoldas-Kulboka-83108/|title=DraftExpress NBA Draft Prospect Profile: Arnoldas Kulboka, Stats, Comparisons, and Outlook|website=draftexpress.com|access-date=13 November 2016}}</ref> as well as the Adidas Eurocamp in Treviso.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.adidaseurocamp.com/eurocamp-2016-roster/|title=EUROCAMP 2016 Roster {{!}} adidas Eurocamp|website=adidaseurocamp.com|access-date=18 November 2016|archive-date=18 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118230657/http://www.adidaseurocamp.com/eurocamp-2016-roster/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In the 2016–17 season, he improved his stats to 14.7 points, 4.3 rebounds and 2 assists per game for Baunach in ProA action. On 1 May 2017, Kulboka made his debut for [[Brose Bamberg]] in [[German basketball league system|Germany's top-tier]] level [[Basketball Bundesliga]], in a 61–74 win over [[Science City Jena]], in which he recorded 13 points and 5 rebounds.<ref>[http://www.easycredit-bbl.de/de/n/spielberichte/2016-17/nachbericht/2017-05-01-jen-bam/#urlNotFound 74:61-Erfolg in Jena: Bamberg geht mit sechs Siegen in Serie in die Playoffs]</ref>

In June 2017, Kulboka participated in adidas Eurocamp. He was named best sniper of the camp, by scoring 10 three-pointers in a row.<ref>{{cite web|title=10 tritaškių iš eilės pataikęs Kulboka – geriausias "Eurocamp" snaiperis|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-110473-10-tritaskiu-is-eiles-pataikes-kulboka-geriausias-eurocamp-snaiperis.html|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=11 June 2017|language=lt}}</ref> Furthermore, he was also named to the First Team All-Eurocamp 2017.<ref>{{cite web|title=2017 Awards|url=http://adidaseurocamp.com/2017-awards/|website=adidas Eurocamp|access-date=23 June 2017|archive-date=2 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211202205824/http://adidaseurocamp.com/2017-awards/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Arnoldas Kulboka – simboliniame prestižinės stovyklos penketuke|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-110485-arnoldas-kulboka-simboliniame-prestizines-stovyklos-penketuke.html|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=11 June 2017|language=lt}}</ref> During the same year, he declared for the [[2017 NBA draft]], but withdrew on 12 June.<ref>{{cite web|title=Masiulis ir Kulboka pateikė paraiškas dalyvauti NBA naujokų biržoje|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-109077-masiulis-ir-kulboka-pateike-paraiskas-dalyvauti-nba-naujoku-birzoje.html|website=BasketNews.lt|language=lt}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Sarapas|first=Jaunius|title=Atsitraukė ir A. Kulboka, ir L. Birutis – NBA naujokų biržoje nebus nė vieno lietuvio|url=http://www.delfi.lt/nba/naujienos/atsitrauke-ir-a-kulboka-ir-l-birutis-nba-naujoku-birzoje-nebus-ne-vieno-lietuvio.d?id=74916202|website=DELFI|access-date=12 June 2017|language=lt}}</ref>

===Orlandina (2017–2018)===
On 14 July 2017, Kubolka joined [[Orlandina Basket]] of the Italian top-tier level [[Lega Basket Serie A|Serie A]], on a [[loan (sports)|loan]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.orlandinabasket.it/a-new-kid-in-town-arnoldas-kulboka-a-capo-dorlando/|title=A New Kid In Town: Arnoldas Kulboka a Capo d'Orlando!|date=14 July 2017|work=Orlandina Basket|access-date=14 July 2017|language=it-IT}}</ref> After averaging 10.3 points, 5 rebounds and 1.1 assists per game during the [[2017–18 Basketball Champions League]] season, he was named the league's [[Basketball Champions League Best Young Player|Best Young Player]] of the season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arnoldas KULBOKA|url=http://www.championsleague.basketball/17-18/Arnoldas-Kulboka|website=championsleague.basketball|access-date=5 May 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Star Lineup revealed, Kulboka Best Young Player|url=http://www.championsleague.basketball/17-18/news/star-lineup-revealed-kulboka-best-young-player|website=championsleague.basketball|access-date=5 May 2018|language=en}}</ref>

===Return to Bamberg (2018–2019)===
On 23 July 2018, Brose Bamberg announced that Kulboka would return to the team.<ref>{{cite web |title=Arnoldas Kulboka kommt nach Bamberg zurück |url=https://www.brosebamberg.de/saison/news/nachricht/artikel/arnoldas-kulboka-kommt-nach-bamberg-zurueck/ |website=brosebamberg.de |access-date=1 August 2018 |language=de-DE |date=23 July 2018}}</ref>

===Bilbao (2019–2021)===
On 6 August 2019, Kulboka signed with [[Liga ACB|Spanish]] club [[Bilbao Basket|RETAbet Bilbao Basket]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Arnoldas Kulboka joins Bilbao |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/arnoldas-kulboka-joins-bilbao/ |access-date=6 August 2019 |work=Sportando |date=6 August 2019}}</ref> He averaged 8.5 points and 3.6 rebounds per game in his first season with the team. On June 12, 2020, Kulboka extended his contract for two seasons.<ref>{{cite news |title=Arnoldas Kulboka extends with Bilbao |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/arnoldas-kulboka-extends-with-bilbao/ |website=Sportando |access-date=June 12, 2020 |date=June 12, 2020 |last=Carchia |first=Emiliano }}</ref> In the summer of 2021, he left Bilbao after receiving an offer from the [[Charlotte Hornets]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Arnoldas Kulboka heading out of Bilbao, two-way contract with Hornets among options |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/nba-news/1222194/arnoldas-kulboka-heading-out-of-bilbao-two-way-contract-with-hornets-among-options/ |website=Eurohoops.net |access-date=16 March 2022|date=25 June 2021}}</ref>

===Charlotte Hornets (2021–2022)===
Near the end of the 2017–18 season, Kulboka would enter his name in the [[2018 NBA draft]], being one of only 11 international players to declare for the draft early that year.<ref>{{cite web |title=Forty-three international early entry candidates withdraw from NBA Draft 2018 |url=http://www.nba.com/article/2018/06/12/forty-three-international-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-nba-draft-2018 |website=NBA.com |access-date=18 June 2018 |date=12 June 2018}}</ref> On 21 June 2018, he was drafted by the [[Charlotte Hornets]], in the second round (55th overall).<ref>{{cite news |last=Fowler |first=Chapel |date=23 June 2018 |title=Hornets to use 'draft and stash' strategy with 55th overall pick Arnoldas Kulboka |page=2B |work=[[The Herald (Rock Hill)|The Herald]] |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/98415455/hornets-to-use-draft-and-stash-strateg/ |access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2018/jun/21/nba-draft-picks-all-teams-live|title=NBA draft 2018: Phoenix Suns select Deandre Ayton with No 1 pick – live!|last=Levitt|first=Daniel|date=22 June 2018|work=The Guardian|access-date=22 June 2018|language=en-GB|issn=0261-3077}}</ref> He represented Hornets during the [[2018 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Arnoldas Kulboka Vasaros lygoje debiutuos "Hornets" gretose |url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-121636-arnoldas-kulboka-vasaros-lygoje-debiutuos-hornets-gretose.html |website=BasketNews.lt |access-date=1 July 2018 |language=lt}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Hornets Announce Roster for MGM Resorts NBA Summer League 2018 |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/hornets-announce-roster-mgm-resorts-nba-summer-league-2018 |website=NBA.com |access-date=25 July 2018 |date=5 July 2018}}</ref> During his debut game he scored 12 points per 13 minutes and helped his team to achieve an 88–87 victory over the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Tritaškį su pražanga pelnęs A.Kulboka galingai debiutavo NBA vasaros lygoje |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/nba/tritaski-su-prazanga-pelnes-a-kulboka-galingai-debiutavo-nba-vasaros-lygoje-1130-997782 |website=24sek.lt |access-date=7 July 2018|language=lt}}</ref> Kulboka represented Hornets during the [[2019 NBA Summer League]] once again.<ref>{{cite web |title=Arnoldas Kulboka dalyvaus NBA Vasaros lygoje – atstovaus "Hornets" |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/nba/arnoldas-kulboka-dalyvaus-nba-vasaros-lygoje-atstovaus-hornets-1130-1167040 |website=[[15min.lt]] |access-date=30 June 2019 |language=lt}}</ref> He played his best game versus the [[China men's national basketball team]], scoring 18 points and grabbing 4 rebounds.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kulboka NBA Vasaros lygoje surengė savo geriausią pasirodymą |url=https://www.delfi.lt/nba/naujienos/kulboka-nba-vasaros-lygoje-surenge-savo-geriausia-pasirodyma.d?id=81671243 |website=[[DELFI]] |access-date=9 July 2019|language=lt}}</ref>

On 3 August 2021, the Charlotte Hornets signed Kulboka to a [[two-way contract]] for the 2021–22 season. Under the terms of the deal, he will split time between the Hornets and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Greensboro Swarm]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Wash |first=Quinton |title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Arnoldas Kulboka and Scottie Lewis To Two-Way Contracts |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-sign-arnoldas-kulboka-and-scottie-lewis-two-way-contracts |website=NBA.com |access-date=3 August 2021 |date=3 August 2021}}</ref>

On 11 December 2021, Kulboka debuted as a Charlotte Hornets member during an NBA game and played 3 minutes.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lauktas debiutas: NBA rungtynėse pasirodė 15-asis lietuvis lygos istorijoje |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/nba/lauktas-debiutas-nba-rungtynese-pasirode-15-asis-lietuvis-lygos-istorijoje-1130-1612226 |website=[[15min.lt]] |access-date=11 December 2021 |language=lt}}</ref> He checked in one more time on 10 April 2022 for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Arnoldas Kulboka 2021-22 Stats per Game - NBA |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4230551/arnoldas-kulboka |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=ESPN |language=en}}</ref>

===Promitheas Patras (2022–2023)===
On 5 July 2022, Kulboka signed a one-year contract with Greek club [[Promitheas Patras B.C.|Promitheas Patras]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Barbaroussis|first=Stavros|title=Arnoldas Kulboka pens one-year deal with Promitheas |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/1365105/arnoldas-kulboka-pens-one-year-deal-with-promitheas/ |website=eurohoops.net |access-date=5 July 2022 |date=5 July 2022}}</ref> On 25 January 2023, Kulboka recorded a career-high 30 points (10/13 [[Field goal|FG]]), four rebounds, three assists and 36-point [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] in an 81–72 home win over [[KK Budućnost|Budućnost VOLI]].

In 27 domestic league matches, Kulboka averaged 12.1 points (shooting with 44% from the 3-point line) and 5.3 rebounds, playing around 28 minutes per contest. Additionally, in 20 [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] games, he averaged 14.7 points and 5.9 rebounds, playing around 31 minutes per contest.

===Prometey (2023–2024)===
On 21 July 2023, Kulboka signed with [[BC Prometey|Prometey]] of the [[Latvian–Estonian Basketball League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Arnoldas Kulboka became a player of BC "Prometey"|url=https://prometeybc.com/en/novosti/arnoldas-kulboka-became-player-bc-prometey|website=PrometeyBC.com|date=21 July 2023|access-date=21 July 2023}}</ref>

===Wolves Twinsbet (2024–2025)===
On 8 August 2024, Kulboka signed with [[BC Wolves|Wolves Twinsbet]] of the [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Wolves Twinsbet adds A. Kulboka to team line-up|url=https://www.bcwolves.com/en/news/wolves-twinsbet-adds-a-kulboka-to-team-line-up|website=BC Wolves|date=8 August 2024|access-date=17 August 2024}}</ref>

===Aris Thessaloniki (2025–present)===
On 15 July 2025, Kulboka signed with [[Aris B.C.|Aris Thessaloniki]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]] (GBL) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Arnoldas Kulboka (ex Wolves) signs at Aris Midea |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Lithuania/news/943434/Arnoldas-Kulboka-ex-Wolves-signs-at-Aris-Midea|website=eurobasket.com|date=15 July 2025|access-date=27 July 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
At the junior youth levels, Kulboka has represented Lithuania on the international stage on several occasions, including at the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_YUjW-7-FJ,kK9s431Lyr41.season_2014.roundID_9771.teamID_2135.playerID_115872.html|title=Arnoldas Kulboka - U16 European Championship Men (2014)|website=fibaeurope.com|access-date=13 November 2016}}</ref> and the [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2015.roundID_11484.teamID_2135.playerID_115872.html|title=Arnoldas Kulboka - U18 Europe Championship Men - Division A|website=u18men.fibaeurope.com|access-date=13 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160323020036/http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2015.roundID_11484.teamID_2135.playerID_115872.html|archive-date=23 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> He scored a team-high 15.7 points a game in the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], en route to a silver medal.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/Lithuania|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170826050521/http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/Lithuania|url-status=live|archive-date=26 August 2017|title=Lithuania at the FIBA U18 European Championship Division A 2016 - FIBA.com|website=FIBA.com|access-date=22 December 2016}}</ref> He also competed for Lithuania in the [[2017 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]], averaging a team-high 13.7 points per contest.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/fr/world/u19/2017/Lithuania|title=Lithuanie at the FIBA U19 Basketball World Cup 2017 - FIBA.basketball|website=FIBA.basketball|language=fr|access-date=9 July 2017}}</ref> On 26 February 2018, Kulboka debuted as a member of the senior [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuanian national team]], by scoring nine points, grabbing five rebounds and dishing out two assists, and helped to crush [[Kosovo national basketball team|Kosovo's national team]], by a score of 106–50, during the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jauna Lietuvos rinktinė su kaupu išnaudojo savo šansą: antrąkart sutriuškintas Kosovas|url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/jauna-lietuvos-rinktine-su-kaupu-isnaudojo-savo-sansa-antrakart-sutriuskintas-kosovas.d?id=77276817|website=DELFI.lt|access-date=26 February 2018|language=lt}}</ref>
